sources.note: Neutrik NC3MXX dimension drawing (opened earlier for the xlr3-f spec, rendered): the male cable connector is 19 mm in diameter and 68.1 - 70.1 mm long. What the model is: the CABLE-END male XLR (a loose plug on a cable, modelled on the NC3MXX), the one that goes onto an xlr3-f jack or plug. role = plug, outerMm = the 19 mm shell.

Neutrik NC3MXX product page: 3-pole male cable connector, nickel housing, IEC 61076-2-103; the bushing is the widest part. The box 20.3 x 20.3 x 69.6 mm is the bounding box of the manufacturer STEP model (20.33 x 20.33 x 69.64 mm, measured in a scratch copy kept outside the repo, geometry not shipped; the dimensions only are used). Pin layout as on the NC3 drawing (pin 2 and 1 left and right, pin 3 below); bore depth 14 mm, pin diameter 1.6 mm and the boot shape are estimates.
